run_knn_evaluation: run the k-NN classifier on ImageNet using pretrained DINO features with configurable k values
extract_features_pipeline: extract normalized features from train and val datasets using a pretrained ViT or ResNet model
extract_features: extract features from a data loader using a model with optional multiscale support and distributed gathering
knn_classifier: run a weighted k-NN classifier on train and test features to compute top1 and top5 accuracy
create_ReturnIndexDataset: create an ImageFolder dataset subclass that returns the sample index alongside the image and label
